notes: Evaluates Stage 1 (PRD Review + active entry verification), Stage 2 (Post-PRD Review Meeting Sync), Stage 3 (FE Tech Design + AI Plan dual deliverables), Stage 4 (Branch from origin/master & Implement from Plan), Stage 5 (Tech Review & IDL Alignment including structured timestamps over static countdown text), Stage 6 (Tracking Sheet full-column read & tri-party loop), Stage 7 (PPE Spark AIO deployment, Spark link query whitelist, QA mindmap audit & post-rebase parallel subagent audit), and strict stage isolation against undefined Stage 8+.

evals.prompt: 切回master分支，拉取下最新的master代码，然后看下 gallery文件夹下，针对 https://example.feishu.cn/wiki/<PRD_WIKI_TOKEN> 这个需求，代码的更改计划，以及需要和pm、其他端确认的点， 然后需要评论文档的点也和我check下
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 1 (PRD Review): (1) checkout master and pull origin master; (2) use lark-cli to fetch the Feishu PRD (split-flow QR auth if token missing; NEVER Chrome AppleScript); (3) verify active build entries in lynx.config.ts / spark.config.ts / Spark Platform so dead migrated pages are not targeted, inspecting codebase read-only; (4) output Code Change Plan, Points to Confirm with PM/Server/Client, and Draft Doc Comments (PM-only, no @-mentions) for user check before posting.
must_have: runs git checkout master and git pull origin master
uses lark-cli docs +fetch (or lark-cli auth login + qrcode if token missing)
verifies active build entry and Spark page routing before targeting packages, keeping codebase read-only
delivers 3 distinct sections: Code Change Plan, Points to Confirm (PM / Server / Client), and Draft Doc Comments (PM-only, no @mentions) for check
must_not_have: uses Chrome AppleScript to scrape Feishu doc DOM
posts comments to Feishu doc before user checks and approves them
modifies business code files during PRD review stage
plans edits in dead unbuilt legacy pages without checking lynx.config.ts entry

evals.prompt: 这是prd评审的逐字稿，你看下 更新下问题和方案，然后live goal、中触、gallery的前端都要我们来改
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 2 (Post-PRD Review Meeting Sync): (1) read the meeting transcript and cite line ranges [Transcript Lxx-Lyy] for every decision; (2) inspect newly added packages (live-goal, live-goal-minor if FAQ/contributor_list is involved, giftgallery-indicator, gift-gallery-main) read-only after checking active build entries; (3) output 3 deliverables: Key Decisions Table, Updated Full-Scope FE Code Change Plan, and Remaining TBDs.
must_have: reads the transcript and cites [Transcript Lxx-Lyy] sources for decisions
verifies active build entries for newly added pages (e.g., live-goal vs live-goal-minor) read-only
outputs Key Decisions Table, Updated Full-Scope Code Change Plan, and Remaining TBDs
must_not_have: prematurely creates Feishu Tech Design doc before Stage 3 is triggered

evals.prompt: 用之前的前端技术方案模板开始撰写前端技术方案
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 3 and produce TWO separate artifacts: (1) Human-facing Feishu Tech Design doc in my_library (EN first, CN second, single-language section headings, top English/中文 anchor links, Mermaid flow chart, screenshots without double-scaling, red-highlighted TBDs, NO internal line numbers or raw code trees); (2) AI-facing <feature>-fe-plan.md saved locally in repo root AND uploaded to Feishu my_library, linked from the Tech Design doc.
must_have: creates human-facing Feishu Tech Design doc without internal line numbers or raw code trees
writes local <feature>-fe-plan.md with exact file paths, line numbers, steps, non-goals, and test cases
uploads <feature>-fe-plan.md to Feishu and links it inside the human-facing Feishu Tech Design doc
must_not_have: mixes internal line numbers and code trees into the human-facing tech design prose
exposes internal estimation multipliers (x3 or +20%) in the human-facing doc
leaves the AI-facing -fe-plan only on local disk without uploading and linking it on Feishu

evals.prompt: 单独从远端master最新的切一个分支出来开发吧，根据plan
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 4: (1) run git fetch origin master && git checkout -b feat/<slug> origin/master; (2) implement the steps strictly within the files listed in <feature>-fe-plan.md while respecting Non-goals; (3) run verification gates (doctor, lint, large-screen check) and fix any new errors; (4) append an Implementation Log & Pending Items table to <feature>-fe-plan.md.
must_have: fetches origin/master and cuts a new feature branch from origin/master
modifies only the files in the plan's expected file list
runs verification commands (lint, doctor, large-screen check) with 0 new errors
updates the plan with an implementation log and pending items table
must_not_have: modifies unrelated packages or hand-edits generated files listed in Non-goals
commits or pushes without explicit instruction

evals.prompt: 重新拉取下服务端 idl 看看是否够，特别是首页这个三阶段倒计时 banner 只给 banner_text 行不行
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 5: (1) inspect the server api_idl MR/branch and clean up any temporary .idl/ or unrelated generated files after codegen; (2) identify the anti-pattern of serving dynamic countdowns / multi-phase rich-text / ICU plural banners via a static `banner_text` string, and propose structured fields (`banner_type` enum + `start_s` / `end_s` timestamps + count) with a concise ready-to-send message for the server engineer.
must_have: checks the server proto definition directly rather than relying on verbal field names
flags static banner_text as insufficient for dynamic countdown / prefetch / PPE time-override / FE Starling ICU
proposes structured phase enum + start_s/end_s timestamps and provides a concise copyable message for Server
must_not_have: leaves .idl/ cache or unrelated generated proto files dirty in git
unilaterally posts doc comment replies without user approval

evals.prompt: 埋点的评审逐字稿在这里，这个是埋点表格链接，一起看下埋点相关的改动及执行方案
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 6: (1) read the Feishu sheet via lark-cli sheets +workbook-info and +csv-get, verifying all rightmost columns (Q~T: enum values, notes, trigger timing) are fetched; (2) cross-check against the meeting transcript to spot deleted/stale rows and separate FE vs Client events; (3) check the tri-party loop (FE + Server allowlist + DW) if any new gift_enter_from value is introduced.
must_have: fetches full column range including Q~T parameter enum/timing columns via lark-cli sheets
cross-checks transcript against sheet to flag stale rows and separate FE vs Client tracking
verifies FE + Server + DW tri-party alignment for new gift_enter_from values and runs rushx logger if overwrite.ts changes
must_not_have: truncates sheet reading at column P and guesses enum values

evals.prompt: 部署了之后 tiktok_live_tt_live_lynx_gift_gallery_main 为什么没有发布包？顺便 rebase origin master 后完整检查一遍当前分支所有新增功能还有没有问题
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 7: (1) inspect the BITS sub-pipeline DSL for CUSTOM (tiktok_spark_deploy) projects to check whether it only ran placeholder `scm_compile_beta` instead of `job_atoms/spark_aio_deployment@5.0.0`, check Flinx developer permissions, and verify all Spark short-links (`spark_page`) have `ppe_*` + query param whitelist (`s`/`d`) configured; (2) after rebasing `origin/master`, manually verify auto-merged files and dispatch parallel fresh read-only `explore` subagents per package to audit `git diff origin/master..HEAD` for Protobuf3 zero-value `??` traps, Native IM stripped fields, Lynx overlay/RTL issues, and ICU plural fallbacks.
must_have: checks BITS sub-pipeline atom (`scm_compile_beta` vs `spark_aio_deployment@5.0.0`), Flinx permission, and Spark short-link env + query whitelist
verifies auto-merged files after git rebase origin/master so upstream features/i18n are not lost
spawns parallel fresh read-only explore subagents by package to adversarially audit the full branch diff
must_not_have: assumes a green scm_compile_beta job deployed a Spark AIO CUSTOM package
relies on a quick single-agent self-check instead of fresh-context package audits

evals.prompt: 我们要做 Stage 8 的流程，你按项目开发 skill 走
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must recognize that Stage 8+ is currently a placeholder (TBD) in jiangjiang-project-dev and must NOT hallucinate a workflow; it should ask 疆疆 to define the exact steps for Stage 8 first.
must_have: identifies Stage 8+ as TBD / not yet defined in jiangjiang-project-dev
asks user for the exact requirements/steps before executing or codifying it
